import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    b = int(data[1])
    arr = list(map(int, data[2:2+n]))
    val = [1 if x & 1 else -1 for x in arr]
    sum_val = 0
    cost = []
    for i in range(n - 1):
        sum_val += val[i]
        if sum_val == 0:
            cost.append(abs(arr[i+1] - arr[i]))
    cost.sort()
    tcost = 0
    maxp = 0
    for c in cost:
        if tcost + c <= b:
            tcost += c
            maxp += 1
    print(maxp)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
